digest: Default compatibility and packaging align; enabled recording has undocumented outcome changes and incompatible shared-directory assumptions.

issues.mismatch: The recorder describes unchanged forwarding, but serialization and filesystem failures can prevent calls or replace completed API outcomes. Usage documentation omits the new control and these operational semantics.
issues.action: Document first-load caching, restart requirements, outcome-affecting recording failures, and private storage/cleanup requirements; qualify unchanged-forwarding language.

issues.mismatch: The producer permits directory reuse while appending calls, restarting sequence numbers, and overwriting surface metadata. Replay sorts only by sequence without producer/session partitioning, and capture replaces filesystem snapshots independently.
issues.action: Require and document fresh exclusive recording directories, or introduce session identity and enforce matching call, surface, and snapshot provenance.

confirmedConsistencies.finding: Unset or blank configuration returns the original API; injected test APIs bypass recording.
Recording preserves enumerable methods and emits the full method surface used by replay feature detection.
The bounded change adds separate recording artifacts without changing existing workflow persistence schemas or requiring migration.
Existing TypeScript inclusion and package src/dist roots accommodate the mandatory recorder import without a new dependency or public export.
